name: Break Reminder
description: Shows a popup reminding you to take a break after a configurable amount of play time.

interval-minutes.name: Reminder interval (minutes)
interval-minutes.description: How many minutes of play before the break popup appears. Maximum is 180 (3 hours).

wait-for-pause.name: Wait for pause inside levels
wait-for-pause.description: If the time is up while you are playing a level, wait until you pause (or leave the level) before showing the popup, so it never interrupts a run.
